messages.subject: Cant load Deducer - could before...
parts:
I (think) that I have Deducer version 0.4-4 installed...
Weirdly cannot now load it - very very :-(((
I have updated packages recently. Could this be linked?

> getRversion()

[1] ‘2.11.1’

> library(Deducer)

Loading required package: ggplot2
Error in parse(n = -1, file = file) :
invalid multibyte character in parser at line 106
Error : unable to load R code in package 'ggplot2'
Error: package 'ggplot2' could not be loaded

Any help most sincerely appreciated. Can i go back to a previous
version?

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Cant load Deducer - could before...
parts:
Dr. Fox,

The error you are getting is with ggplot2 not Deducer. I would
recommend that you update your R to 2.14.x.

Ian
